info.name: WA Panel - All APIs
info.description:
All APIs of the WA Panel (wa.jscoretech.com). Full reference: docs/API.md.

Set the collection variables first: app_url (https://wa.jscoretech.com or http://localhost:3100), api_key (Profile → API Access Key), to (test number with country code), template, and the keys for the folders you use.

Folders:
1. REST API v2: the recommended API (X-API-Key header, JSON)
2. Legacy API v1: /api/secure/v1 (access_key or username + password in the body)
3. Legacy URLs: old file / Laravel URLs that still work
4. Leads CRM webhook
5. Webhooks & callbacks called by Meta, Shopify and CCAvenue
6. Outgoing: the CRM WA API this app calls

Requests that send messages send real WhatsApp messages: use your own test number.

item.name: 1. REST API v2
item.description:
Send WhatsApp templates, text and attachments, check message status, and list / create templates.

Set the collection variables before sending:
- base_url: your API base URL
- api_key: your API key (Profile → API Access Key); it is sent in the X-API-Key header
- to: a test mobile number with country code, e.g. 919876543210

Responses are {"success": true, "data": …} or {"success": false, "error": {"code", "message", "field"}}.
Text and attachment messages need the customer to have written to you in the last 24 hours.
Sending a message saves its id in the message_id variable for "Message status".

query.description: 1 = fetch the latest templates from WhatsApp first

request.description: Approved templates with body_parameters, header, buttons (dynamic URL buttons and their index), cards and can_send. Enable the query parameters you need.

Submits a standard template to WhatsApp for review. It can be sent once approved (List templates with sync=1). category: MARKETING or UTILITY. header_type: NONE, TEXT, IMAGE, VIDEO or DOCUMENT. Buttons: QUICK_REPLY {text}, URL {text, url, example}, PHONE_NUMBER {text, phone}.

formdata.value: Hi {{1}}, our festive offer is live! Visit us today.

formdata.description: JSON array, one sample per body variable

request.description: Media headers need a sample file, so this request is multipart/form-data. List fields are sent as JSON strings.
parameters: body values for {{1}}, {{2}}, … in order. to may also be an array or comma-separated list (up to 100 numbers; then the response is 202 and messages are sent in the background).

header_url: for image / video / document templates (public URL ending in .jpg/.png, .mp4 or .pdf). header_parameter: value for {{1}} in a text header. button_parameters: dynamic URL button values by button index. Remove the fields your template does not use.
Uploads the header media instead of a URL. Repeat parameters[] for each body value.
One entry in cards per card of the template: media_url (.jpg/.png, or .mp4 for video cards), parameters for the card body, button_parameters for dynamic URL buttons.
Only within 24 hours of the customer's last message (otherwise error window_closed: send a template). Up to 4096 characters; WhatsApp formatting such as *bold* works.
Up to 3 buttons show as buttons (20 characters each); up to 10 show as a list (24 characters). Titles must not contain commas.
Within the 24-hour window. Images (.jpg, .png, .webp), videos (.mp4, .3gp), documents (.pdf, .doc(x), .xls(x), .ppt(x), .txt, .csv), up to 16 MB. The URL must end in the file extension.
Same as Send attachment, uploading the file (multipart/form-data).
status: processing, queued, sent, delivered, read, failed (see error), opted_out or cancelled. message_id is filled in by the last send request.

item.name: 2. Legacy API v1 (/api/secure/v1)
item.description: POST JSON (or form fields / query string). Responses are {"status": "...", "message": "...", "result": {...}}. status "200" = queued / sent, "202" Invalid Username (wrong access_key or username/password), "207" User WA Plan Expired, "208" Template Message Limit Reached, "209" Template Category Not Allowed. Unknown action: {"status": 0, "message": "Invalid Request"}.

request.description:
Legacy API (old waapi/api.php). Authenticate with access_key (Profile → API Access Key) or username + password in the body. receiverMobileNo: one number, comma-separated numbers or an array. filePathUrl: array of public file links. bot "1" (or opt "1") = send at once; otherwise the message waits for the sender queue. messageButtons: ["Yes,No"] reply buttons with title. type / opt "1" can switch the message type (opt "1" = Authentication). Returns result.id = message id for Message status. Alias action: create_wa.

Responses are {"status": "...", "message": "...", "result": {...}}. status "200" = queued / sent, "202" Invalid Username (wrong access_key or username/password), "207" User WA Plan Expired, "208" Template Message Limit Reached, "209" Template Category Not Allowed. Unknown action: {"status": 0, "message": "Invalid Request"}.

Same endpoint, authenticated with the panel username and password instead of access_key, with reply buttons.

Responses are {"status": "...", "message": "...", "result": {...}}. status "200" = queued / sent, "202" Invalid Username (wrong access_key or username/password), "207" User WA Plan Expired, "208" Template Message Limit Reached, "209" Template Category Not Allowed. Unknown action: {"status": 0, "message": "Invalid Request"}.

body.raw:
{
  "username": "{{username}}",
  "password": "{{password}}",
  "receiverMobileNo": "{{to}}",
  "message": "Would you like a call back?",
  "title": "Call back",
  "messageButtons": [
    "Yes,No"
  ],
  "bot": "1"
}

request.description:
Send an approved template. template = template name, template_parameters = body values ({{1}}, {{2}} …) as an array or comma-separated string, attachment = header media URL, urlButtons = dynamic URL button value. The message is grouped into the campaign named after the template. result.id is always "0" on this endpoint.

Responses are {"status": "...", "message": "...", "result": {...}}. status "200" = queued / sent, "202" Invalid Username (wrong access_key or username/password), "207" User WA Plan Expired, "208" Template Message Limit Reached, "209" Template Category Not Allowed. Unknown action: {"status": 0, "message": "Invalid Request"}.
Delivery status of a message sent with send_message: result = sent, delivered, read, error … (null when unknown). No authentication (by message id).
Stores the request (body + query) in js_api_data_log (Google Sheet add-on logging). Optional Api-Key header and userEmail. Returns {"status":1,"message":"Success"}.

Google Sheet add-on: activate sheetId for a registered user email (valid 365 days). Form or JSON fields userEmail, sheetId, sheetType. status 1 = Sheet Successfully Activated / Sheet Already Active, 0 / 1001 = Invalid Email ID.
Google Sheet add-on: is sheetId active? status 1 "Sheet is Active" with result.user_email, 0 "Sheet Not Active".
Data Extractor desktop tool. Plain-text answer: OK or Invalid Activation Key.
Marks the key as logged in. Plain text: OK, Invalid Activation Key or Activation Key Already Login.
Logs the key out. Plain text: OK or Invalid Activation Key.

item.name: 4. Leads CRM webhook
item.description: https://<app>/api/crm/<key>: the key is shown in CRM → Settings (accounts with CRM switched on).

request.description: Leads CRM webhook URL from CRM → Settings. Without hub.* parameters: {"ok":true,"message":"The CRM webhook is ready…"}. Unknown key: 404.
Facebook subscription handshake: answers the hub.challenge as text when hub.verify_token matches the CRM verify token, else 403.

Add a lead from a website form, Zapier, Make, Pabbly or Google Ads. JSON, form-urlencoded or multipart. Recognised keys (any case): name / full_name / first_name + last_name, mobile / phone / whatsapp, email, source / utm_source, campaign / utm_campaign / form_name, message / notes / remarks; other keys are kept as extra fields. Body may be one lead, an array, {"leads":[…]} (up to 100) or {"data":{…}}. Response {"ok":true,"saved":1,"duplicates":0,"lead_ids":[…]}; 422 when no name / mobile / email; 413 over 256 KB.
Same as above with form fields.

Facebook Lead Ads page notification. When a Facebook app secret is saved, X-Hub-Signature-256 (sha256 HMAC of the raw body) is required, else 403 Invalid signature. The lead answers are read from the Graph API with the saved Page token.

item.name: 5. Webhooks & callbacks
item.description: Called by Meta, Shopify and CCAvenue. Signatures are checked, so most of these only succeed with a valid signature.

request.description: Callback URL of the Meta app (also /waapi/webhook.php and /waapi/wawebhook.php). Echoes hub.challenge when hub.verify_token equals META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN or any account API key; 403 otherwise.

Incoming messages and delivery statuses from WhatsApp Cloud API. Signed by Meta (X-Hub-Signature-256 with META_APP_SECRET; 401 if wrong). Always answers {"status":"200","msg":"1"}; inbox, auto-replies, bot flows and forwarding to the account's webhook URL run after the response. Do not send test payloads to production: they create real inbox messages.
Agency Meta app (Page object, field leadgen). Token from Settings → Meta Lead Ads Keys.
leadgen notifications. X-Hub-Signature-256 is required (401 Invalid signature); answers EVENT_RECEIVED and reads the lead afterwards (retried by the meta-leads job).
Logs the payload and echoes hub.challenge (GET or POST). /waapi/newwebhook.php behaves the same.

Shopify "Order creation" webhook → sends the order confirmation template (SHOPIFY_ORDER_TEMPLATE) with parameters name, order number. X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 is checked when SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set. Old URL: /waapi/shopify.php?at=new_order. Response {"data":{"id":"0","status":"Success"},"msg":"Success","status":"200"}; "201" when the phone is missing.
Shopify checkout webhook → abandoned checkout template (SHOPIFY_CART_TEMPLATE); the URL button gets the path + query of abandoned_checkout_url.
CCAvenue return / cancel URL. Form field encResp (encrypted with the CCAvenue working key). Records the payment and answers 303 → /payment/result. Only CCAvenue can build a valid encResp.

item.name: 6. Outgoing: CRM WA API
item.description: APIs this app calls (for testing the configuration).

request.description: Outgoing call made by the app, not an endpoint of this project: the daily 11:00 report (Settings → CRM WA) posts one message per page of expiring / low-limit users. The image is a PNG under {{app_url}}/media/reports/… passed as filePathUrl. Use this request to test the CRM WA key and group.
